snippet.title: Sylvan Tactics - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Sylvan Tactics is a strategy game where creature battles take place on a chess board.

Move your units using familiar chess movement, recruit woodland Mercenaries, play powerful cards, manipulate the battlefield, and outmaneuver your opponent to bring down their King.

Every match blends positional tactics with unpredictable card interactions, creating a strategy game that rewards clever positioning, adaptability, and creative plays.

🔔 Wishlist Sylvan Tactics on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4254510/Sylvan_Tactics/

♟️ Learn more: https://www.sylvantactics.com

Join us as we prepare for upcoming Steam playtests, Steam Next Fest, and the release of Sylvan Tactics.

#SylvanTactics #IndieGame #StrategyGame #CardGame #Chess #Deckbuilder #Steam
